messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: assembling RC for embed-service, aiming to cut at 09:30 PT. Need a fast litmus + two-stage canary. Who can own the promo?

alex: I can take promo ownership. what9s the artifact tag?

maria: tag is embed-service@2026-03-23-rc4

deploy-bot: Candidate created: embed-service@2026-03-23-rc4 (id: cand-1751112222). CI green. Recommend KV warm.

tim: starting litmus (smoke set) now, ETA 5m.

qa-bot: Litmus results: 118/120 pass, two failures (one minor wording, one rerank). See https://ci.redwood/cand/1751112222

maria: paste examples? need to assess severity.

tim: example:
```
input: "Summarize invoice"
expected: "Total amount: $1,234.56"
actual: "Amount total: $1,234.56"
```
wording swap, low impact.

alex: reranker case looks like config drift. tagging @sara to confirm.

sara: confirmed: default threshold bumped in staging config. will apply runtime override on candidate to restore previous behavior.

ops-bot: Applied config override to cand-1751112222: reranker.threshold=0.72 (audit cfg-1751).

tim: re-running litmus after override.

qa-bot: Litmus now 120/120 :white_check_mark:.

maria: good. starting KV warm and 10% canary. commands:
```
./deployctl kv-warm --candidate=cand-1751112222 --timeout=12m
./deployctl traffic-split --candidate=cand-1751112222 --pct=10
```

deploy-bot: KV warm initiated. traffic-split 10%.

infra-monitor: monitoring p95/p99. initial 10m warm looks OK.

bri: telemetry stable: p95 +2ms, errors unchanged.

maria: propose pin for promo window 10:00-12:00 PT, reserve rollback. objections?

sheriff: ack. abort rule: sustained error_rate >0.4% for 5m triggers rollback. I'll be on-call.

deploy-bot: Candidate pinned as pin-1751112222. Promo window scheduled 10:00-12:00 PT.

alex: final checks all green. calling for signoff (reply with \"\u2705\").

sara: \u2705

tim: \u2705

bri: \u2705

sheriff: \u2705 (watching)

maria: promoting at 10:05 PT unless we see issues. quiet window in effect (no DB changes).

-- 10:07 PT --

deploy-bot: Promotion started for cand-1751112222 -> prod, rolling in cohorts.

infra-monitor: Cohort 1 (5%) steady.

infra-monitor: Cohort 2 (25%) saw brief p99 blip in eu-west, resolved within 60s, no errors.

sheriff: holding for 3m to confirm stability.

alex: investigating eu-west logs: one node hit long GC due to a memory-heavy batch; scaled pool by +1.

deploy-bot: Autoscale event eu-west: +1 node, warmup ~60s.

infra-monitor: metrics normalizing.

sheriff: good to continue.

deploy-bot: Cohort 3 (60%) promoted. Cohort 4 (100%) starting.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: cand-1751112222 -> prod :shipit:.

maria: promo successful. @ryan can you add release note summary to RB-6622 and call out the reranker override?

ryan: Added: "embed-service RC4 promoted to prod. Applied reranker.threshold override (0.72) to maintain ranking parity. No model change."

maria: thanks all, closing thread. :tada:
